name: Refinishing an Occupied Redmond Home: Room-by-Room Scheduling
title-tag: Refinishing While You Live at Home | Redmond, WA
meta-description: You can live at home during a hardwood refinish. A Redmond contractor explains room-by-room phasing — schedule, trade-offs, and when it's the wrong call.
post-summary: October 16, 2026 · Most of our Redmond clients live at home through their refinish. The trick is phasing: split the house into zones, refinish one while you live in the other, swap at the 48–72 hour furniture mark. The full schedule, the honest trade-offs, and the floor plans where we'd recommend a hotel instead.
